text:
Sam - Sales: Heads up — PineRiver sent over a SIG/CAIQ and a BYOK note. They want answers + evidence by EOD Friday. Can security own? https://files.pineriver/example.pdf

Priya - Security: I can take initial ownership. Need to triage: is BYOK mandatory or optional? Also need SOC2 cert and network diagram.

Sam - Sales: BYOK flagged as "required for production" in their questionnaire. POC scheduled next week so this is blocking the contract.

Luis - Solutions: On the POC side, BYOK will add ops work. If they require HSM-backed keys, ETA slips ~2 weeks. Can we get a waiver for POC?

Anika - SalesEng: I spoke with their engineer earlier — they said POC can use cloud KMS, production requires BYOK/HSM. They want evidence we support both. :eyes:

Priya - Security: Ok. Action items: 1) Claim thread + create ticket, 2) collect SOC2 and encryption docs, 3) confirm KMS/HSM support matrix, 4) propose temporary POC origin plan.

sec-queue-bot: Ticket SR-3421 created and assigned to Priya - Security — https://redwood.internal/tickets/SR-3421

Priya - Security: Dropping required evidence list in thread: - latest SOC2 report - network architecture diagram (ingress/egress paths) - KMS key rotation policy and ARNs - encryption at rest statement + config (e.g., `S3 SSE-KMS`) - any penetration test summary or vuln scan

Luis - Solutions: I'll prepare a POC plan doc and a short note on how we support BYOK: quantized steps + ops responsibilities. Will link artifacts to `s3://redwood-evidence/pineriver/` by EOD tomorrow.

Anika - SalesEng: Also need pricing note — if BYOK/HSM required for production, add delta estimate. Sales needs a conservative number to include in contract.

Priya - Security: Priya here — marking owner for evidence collection. Can you both (Luis/Anika) drop preliminary artifacts? I can validate and mark claims in the SIG.

Sam - Sales: Thanks. I'll update the customer that security has the owner and we expect initial evidence tomorrow. Will negotiate POC waiver for production BYOK requirement in parallel.

Luis - Solutions: Uploaded draft POC plan + KMS support notes: `s3://redwood-evidence/pineriver/poc-plan-v1.pdf`

Priya - Security: Got it. Starting SIG claims now. Quick question: do we have a templated network diagram? If not I can sketch one from infra notes.

Anika - SalesEng: We have a generic diagram in the sales repo: https://git.redwood/sales/pocs/diagrams/network-template.png — feel free to adapt.

Priya - Security: Cool — will adapt and annotate where BYOK changes behaviour.

sec-queue-bot: Reminder: SR-3421 SLA 72 hours for first evidence upload. Current age: 6 hours.

Sam - Sales: If security flags any blocker to the contract timeline, call it out ASAP. I can push deadline but need concrete ask. :thumbsup:

Priya - Security: Noted. If PineRiver insists on HSM for production, that's a policy exception and needs org signoff. I'll flag that in SR-3421 and propose interim mitigations.

Anika - SalesEng: For pricing delta: estimate +$8k/mo for dedicated HSM + ops. I'll confirm with finance and post numbers.

Luis - Solutions: FYI, for the POC waiver, we can offer ephemeral cloud-managed keys and strict access constraints for the POC period. Documented in the POC plan.

Priya - Security: Ok team — next check-in here tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll update SR-3421 with SIG claim statuses and list of missing evidence.

Sam - Sales: Perfect. Thanks all.
